result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, with one clear content defect: the promo badge on the second 'Popular right now' card reads '−100%', which is an implausible discount value. Carousel clipping on the right and the cut-off card at the bottom are expected scroll behaviour and not reported.

issues.description: The promo badge on the pizza restaurant card in 'Popular right now' shows '−100%', which is an implausible discount (everything free) and likely a wrong or unformatted value from a data or calculation error.
issues.suggestion: Check the discount data source and calculation for this badge; show the correct percentage (e.g. −10% or −20%) and add validation to hide or cap the badge when the value is out of a sensible range.
